description: Sends a request for a new Fathomed bot to Company Framework: what the bot should do and for which trade, with an optional email for word when it ships. Requests are read weekly; one requested bot can ship each week.

email.description: Optional. Where to say it shipped.

idea.description: What the bot should do, in a sentence or two.

trade.description: The trade or kind of business.

name: request_a_bot
title: Request a Fathomed bot
